title: The Cursed Mod [TCM]
description: Adds unholy things that should not be in Minecraft.
body:
# The Cursed Mod [TCM]

>***!!!VERY IMPORTANT!!!***  
**This mod is intended to be a silly and stupid mod that I work on *for fun*. The most important thing about this project is that it get its humor from being random and stupid (like asdf). Please don't take anything in this mod seriously at all. Thanks.**

This mod seeks to add weird and unholy things that should not be in Minecraft and then string them together with Terraria-like progression. Currently, there is one game stage with linear progression, although much more is planned.

**CURRENT FEATURES:**
- New items
- A new tool
- New weapons
- New blocks
- A new crafting station
- A new villager profession
- New mobs
- Four new bosses with summoning items obtained through progression
- New structures
- Miscellanious other stuff

**PLANNED FEATURES:**

- More of all of the above, including 11 more bosses and more villager professions linked to progression
- New armor
- New abilities
- 2 more stages of progression
- A new difficulty (sort of)

![Boss Map](https://i.imgur.com/CZvFXiS.png)  
*Bosses implemented and bosses yet to come.*

>**PROGRESSION GUIDE**  
>- Notes: 
>   - **Essences** are obtained by killing bosses (and escaping the backrooms). They can be crafted into **Essence Blocks**.
>   - **Blast-Proof Glass** can be crafted and is basically immune to explosions (useful for building arenas).
>   - **Anomalies** can spawn underground. They take you to **The Backrooms** when walked into.
>       - To escape **The Backrooms**, you must find the **Microwave** and kill it (don't ask).
>   - **Uranium Ore** can be found underground. It drops several uranium related items.
>- Pre-boss:
>   - **Slime Caves** can be found underground. You know you've found one when you see patches of slime blocks on the ground and an all-stone floor.
>       - **Cave Slimes** of all sizes can spawn here. They drop **Souls of Slime**, a crafting ingredient.
>       - **Slime Cave Shrines** can be found here. They will always contain a **Royal Slime Medallion**.
>       - **Slimy Sword Shrines** can also be found here. They contain a sword in the stone that can be mined to obtain the **Slimexcalibur**
>   - The **Royal Slime Medallion** is needed to summon the first boss. It can be found in **Slime Cave Shrines** or crafted with a **Soul of Slime** and various other items.
>   - The **Slime King** is the first boss of the mod. It can be  summoned by using the **Royal Slime Medallion**.
>       - On death, it drops **Souls of Slime**, **Royal Slimeballs**, and the **Liquifier**.
>           - **Royal Slimeballs** are a crafting ingredient.
>               - **Royal Slime Blocks** can be crafted with **Royal Slimeballs**.
>               - The **Slime Hat** can be crafted with a **Royal Slime Block**, **Souls of Slime** and **Blocks of Overworld Essence**.
>               - The **Slimexcalibur** can also be crafted with **Royal Slime Blocks**, **Souls of Slime**, and a **Block of Overworld Essence** if you couldn't find it earlier.
>               - The **Slimaxe** can be crafted with a **Royal Slime Block**, **Souls of Slime**, and **Blocks of Overworld essence**.
>           - The **Liquifier** is a new crafting station. It must be powered with a water bucket, and primarily serves as a source of new liquids and bottled liquids.
>               - I'll add a full list of **Liquifier** recipes later.
>- Post-Slime King:
>   - **Speedrunners** can be found in the Nether. They drop **Souls of Speed**, a crafting ingredient.
>   - **Speed Singularities** can be crafted with **Souls of Speed** and several other items.
>   - **Ender Pearl Blocks** can be crafted with ender pearls.
>   - A **Block of Dream** can be crafted with **Souls of Speed**, a **Speed Singularity**, and **Ender Pearl Blocks**.
>   - The **Core of Dream** is needed to summon the second boss. It can be crafted by liquifying a **Block of Dream** with a diamond.
>   - **Dream** is the second boss of the mod. He can be summoned by using the **Core of Dream**.
>       - On death, he drops **Souls of Speed** and the **Totem of the Speedrunner**. His defeat also unlocks the **Mining Dimension**.
>           - The **Totem of the Speedrunner** is an item that, when held in the main hand, gives a large speed boost.
>           - The **Mining Dimension** is the source of multiple new ores that will be mentioned in the next section.
>           - He also has a 10% chance of dropping **The Manhunter**, a powerful weapon.
>- Post-Dream:
>   - The **Mining Dimension** is unlocked now, giving access to lots of new content. It can be entered by finding a **Mining Portal Altar** in the overworld and right-clicking the portal block. To get back, find a **Return Portal Altar** in the **Mining Dimension**.
>       - **Loam** can be found on the surface and underground **Mining Dimension**. It is a crafting ingredient and is also used as ammo for the **Loam Gun**.
>           - **Loam Boots** can be crafted with loam and can be used to do powerful loam jump.
>           - The **Loam Gun** can be crafted with **Loam**, a **Block of Nether Essence**, a **Block of Overworld Essence**, and the **Void Catalyst**. It is a very powerful weapon that uses **Loam** as ammo.
>       - **Dreamite** can be found underground in the **Mining Dimension** and can be crafted into ingots by combining it with **Souls of Speed** and **Uranium Dust**.
>           - The **Dreamfruit** can be crafted with **Dreamite Ingots**, **Blocks of Overworld Essence**, **Blocks of Nether Essence**, and an **Enchanted Golden Apple**. It gives *permanent* Luck I and Speed II.
>       - **Void Crystals** can be found in geodes near the bottom of the **Mining Dimension**.
>           - The **Void Catalyst** is needed to summon the third boss. It can be crafted with **Void Crystals**, **Blocks of Overworld Essence**, **Blocks of Nether Essence**, and a **Soul of Void**.
>               - The **Void Catalyst** can also be used instead of a water bucket in the **Liquifier** to duplicate items with **Void Crystals**, and is *not* consumed upon being crafted with.
>       - **Void Enemies** can be found on the surface of the **Mining Dimension** at night, or underground in the **Mining Dimension** at any time. They drop **Souls of Void**, a crafting ingredient.
>   - The **Super Sheep** is the third boss of the mod. It can be summoned by using the **Void Catalyst** near a sheep or by using the **Sheep Catalyst**.
>       - On death, it drops **Souls of Void**, **Souls of Sheep**, the **Sheep Catalyst**, and the **Adventuring Table**.
>           - **Souls of Sheep** are a crafting ingredient.
>               - The **Loxcalibur** can be crafted by liquifying the **Slimexcalibur** with a **Soul of Sheep**.
>           - The **Sheep Catalyst** can be used to summon the **Super Sheep** without a sheep.
>           - The **Adventuring Table** is a block that is used to get the new **Adventurer** villager profession.
>- Post-Super Sheep:
>   - The **Adventurer** villager sells items from previous points in progression, as well as **Wandering Trader Voodoo Dolls**, which are needed to summon the fourth boss.
>   - **Trader's Revenge** is the current final boss of the mod, and the final boss of the first stage of progression. He can be summoned by dropping a **Wandering Trader Voodoo Doll** into lava with a wandering trader nearby.
>       - Currently, **Trader's Revenge** has no drops.

This mod requires **[Geckolib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib "Geckolib")** in order to function properly. **[JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei "Just Enough Items (JEI)")** is also recommended but not required. This mod works on **[NeoForge](https://neoforged.net "NeoForge")** and only **NeoForge**. No, I cannot port the mod to other versions/loaders.
